title: 安田記念の後に・『力』と、

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle overcomes the poor track conditions with sheer strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having successfully fired up the crowd with a powerful performance, Taiki radiates pure happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next race she sets her sights on is a little short of a mile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hoping to make a good impression on the spectators, she chooses to run in the Sprinters Stakes!
